title: UPSSSC Cartographer / Manchitrak Mains Exam Result 2026

shortDescription: UPSSSC has released the Cartographer / Manchitrak Mains Exam Result 2026 for Advt No. 11-Exam/2023. Check the result notice and official result link.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Cartographer / Manchitrak Mains Exam Result 2026 for Advt No. 11-Exam/2023.

This recruitment is for 283 posts, including 250 Nakshanveesh Cartographer posts and 33 Manchitrak posts. Candidates who appeared in the mains examination can check their result through the official UPSSSC result portal.

Important dates

  • Application started: 18 December 2023
  • Registration and fee payment last date: 08 January 2024
  • Correction last date: 15 January 2024
  • Eligibility result: 17 May 2025
  • Mains result: 07 September 2026

How to check the result

  1. Open the official UPSSSC result link.
  2. Select the Cartographer / Manchitrak Mains Result 2026 link.
  3. Enter the required login details, if requested.
  4. Download the result and result notice.
  5. Keep a printout for the next stage of the selection process.

Vacancy details

  • Nakshanveesh Cartographer: 250 posts
  • Manchitrak: 33 posts

Read the official notification and result notice carefully for eligibility, document requirements and further instructions.
